title: Class Compass theme package
description: Version 1. Generated from src/shared/themePackage/schema.ts by scripts/theme-docs.ts; do not edit.

key.description: The theme key classes store. Not a built-in key; unique in the school.

base.description: Built-in theme that supplies missing art and colour tokens added after this package was made.

colors.description: Every colour token except print-ink and print-paper (always black on white). Opaque #rrggbb, except overlay, shadow-color and avatar-outline (#rrggbb or #rrggbbaa). scene-scrim may be left out (it is then the package surface). See the token table in docs/THEMING.md.

display.description: Font preset of headings and big classroom text.

trackingBody.description: Letter-spacing of body text in em (0 = normal).

trackingDisplay.description: Letter-spacing of headings in em (0 = normal).

celebrate.description: Plays once on the mascot when the class celebrates.

threshold.description: Plays once when the class counter bar fills.

gain.description: Peak gain of the main voice; the tap must still peak between -12 and -6 dBFS at volume 80.

tempo.description: Speed: above 1 is snappier, below 1 calmer.

overrides.description: Hand-made cues for single events; every limit still applies.

sounds.description: null keeps the theme silent (every visual signal stays).

colors.description: Colour tokens of the celebration fireworks.

mascot.description: All five poses in a 100x100 box, all different. Without it the base theme mascot is used.

idle.description: An SVG fragment (no <svg> element) using only the allowed elements and attributes (docs/THEMING.md).

cheer.description: An SVG fragment (no <svg> element) using only the allowed elements and attributes (docs/THEMING.md).

thinking.description: An SVG fragment (no <svg> element) using only the allowed elements and attributes (docs/THEMING.md).

celebrate.description: An SVG fragment (no <svg> element) using only the allowed elements and attributes (docs/THEMING.md).

sleepy.description: An SVG fragment (no <svg> element) using only the allowed elements and attributes (docs/THEMING.md).

illustrations.description: Any of the six illustrations in a 200x140 box; missing ones come from the base theme.

lockScreen.description: An SVG fragment (no <svg> element) using only the allowed elements and attributes (docs/THEMING.md).

emptyState.description: An SVG fragment (no <svg> element) using only the allowed elements and attributes (docs/THEMING.md).

threshold.description: An SVG fragment (no <svg> element) using only the allowed elements and attributes (docs/THEMING.md).

startLesson.description: An SVG fragment (no <svg> element) using only the allowed elements and attributes (docs/THEMING.md).

endLesson.description: An SVG fragment (no <svg> element) using only the allowed elements and attributes (docs/THEMING.md).

celebration.description: An SVG fragment (no <svg> element) using only the allowed elements and attributes (docs/THEMING.md).

art.description: An SVG fragment for one scene layer (no <svg> element), the same allow-list as other art; at most 60 KB and 1500 elements.

viewBox.description: The coordinate box of the art, e.g. "0 0 1920 1080".

fit.description: cover crops to fill the screen, contain shows all of it, width / height fit one side.

anchor.description: Which part stays in view when cropped, or where a smaller layer sits.

maxHeightVh.description: Highest the layer may be, in percent of the screen height (e.g. 45 keeps a village in the lower part).

layers.description: Drawn back to front: the first layer is the farthest.

smallScreens.description: Below the phone breakpoint: full, only the last layer as a strip at the bottom (bottomStrip), or none (hidden).

scene.description: Viewport-scale artwork fixed behind the app (decorative). Text never sits on it: boxes and bars keep their surfaces and headings on the page get a scene-scrim panel.

edge.description: Card silhouette: snow piled on top, a scalloped edge, a torn paper edge.

trim.description: A band around the boxes listed in trimOn (default none).

corners.description: Small accents at the corners (default none).

apply.description: Surfaces that get the edge and corners (default boardBoxes, studentCards, topBar). studentCards and cards get the edge only; dialogs get the edge and corners; the trim is only on the board boxes in trimOn.

trimOn.description: Board boxes that get the trim (box keys of the classroom board; default routine and core.timer).

snowColor.description: Colour token of the edge shape (default per edge: art-ground for snowDrift, surface otherwise).

trimColors.description: Colour tokens of the trim (default per trim, e.g. accent and surface for candyStripe).

cornerColors.description: Colour tokens of the corners (default per corner preset).

frame.description: App-drawn frames from presets only (no SVG in the package). Colours are token names. Phones and compact density get the edge only.

density.description: Number of particles on a 1920x1080 screen (fewer on smaller screens).

color.description: Colour token of the particles (default: surface for snowfall, deco-1..3 for leaves).

ambient.description: A silent background animation on one canvas between the scene and the content, at most 30 frames a second. With the class animation switch off or reduced motion it draws one still frame.

achievementFrame.description: A frame around the badge art; the tier keeps its shape, colour token and word.

avatarFamiliesFirst.description: Creature families shown first in the avatar picker; nothing is hidden and saved avatars never change.

mascotFrom.description: A built-in theme whose mascot to use when the package has no mascot art (default: the base theme).

sets.description: Choose and recolour built-in sets (no custom avatar or badge art).
